mission_08: Building a comprehensive text augmentation pipeline requires combining multiple strategies to maximize dataset diversity. Synonym replacement swaps words with their semantic equivalents, random insertion adds new words from synonym sets, random swap changes word order locally, and random deletion removes words to create shorter variants. Together, these techniques form the foundation of EDA (Easy Data Augmentation), a widely adopted approach for NLP tasks with limited training data. The key insight is that each strategy introduces a different type of variation, and combining them creates a rich set of augmented examples. Care must be taken to preserve sentence meaning and grammatical structure, especially when applying multiple augmentations simultaneously.
